description: A morse code translator both ways — text to morse code, and morse code to text. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

direction.description: Which way to translate. "auto" decodes when the input is nothing but dots, dashes, spaces and slashes, and encodes otherwise; "toMorse" and "toText" force one direction. Anything with no morse equivalent comes back as <x> and is listed in `unsupported`.

text.description: Plain text to turn into morse, or morse to turn back into text. Morse is dots and dashes with a space between letters and a slash (or two spaces) between words; middle dots and en or em dashes are accepted as well.

name: morse_code_translator
title: Morse Code Translator
